title: THE THRONE OF AETHORIA
entrance_text: The System pulses with recognition. It has always known you — every choice, every unexpected deviation, every moment you refused the path it laid. Now you stand at its heart, and it waits. Behind you, the Iron Vanguard holds the corridors. The Crown's seal burns at your wrist. Ahead: the Core, and a throne that has never been occupied by anything that bleeds.

root.text: The Fracture Core antechamber has transformed. Somehow it knows what you intend. Interface panels manifest around you — Class reassignments, faction orders, death-record clearances. The System is offering you the controls. All you have to do is reach out and take them.

options.label: Step forward and speak to the System directly
Hesitate — consider the weight of what you are about to do
Reconsider — look back toward the tunnels

the_cost.text: You think about what this means. Every class assignment. Every life token. Every death record. You would control all of it — the entire apparatus of a world rebuilt after the Fracture. You could make it just. Or you could make it yours. The distinction has always been the question.

options.label: Proceed with the intent to make it just
Proceed — justice is a luxury, power is what endures

negotiate_system.text:
The System responds. Not in words — in interface. Your entire history manifests before you: every choice, every flag, every death, every faction standing. It is showing you that it knows you. Asking if you know yourself.

You reach into the Core and make the interface your own.

options.label: Accept full rulership — become the System's voice in flesh
Demand reforms first — the System serves people, not the reverse
Take control by force — no negotiations, no conditions

victory_rule.text:
It is done.

The System accepts its new authority structure. Across Aethoria, class assignments shift. Death records are reviewed. Life tokens are redistributed. The alignment apparatus bends toward something new — not perfect, but directed by a will that once walked the same roads as everyone else.

In Verath, the Crown dissolves peacefully. The Iron Vanguard receives new orders. In the Undermarket, the Shadow Network goes quiet.

The System endures. The Fracture is stabilized. And somewhere in the data architecture of a machine that rewrote the world, your name is written where the root commands live.

You did not destroy it. You became it.

[ END — RULER PATH ]
[ Aethoria is yours to govern. ]

options.label: [ The story of your rule begins now. ]
